mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance system to the body was most worthwhile: the final picture showed what the routes actually help the eyes and posture do.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor types was less interesting on its own; it placed them together but did not yet show their effect on movement.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond not just to tilt but also to changes in straight-line movement.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly purposeless, though several connections were the only offered combination, so there was little meaningful choice in their order.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the finished system explain a familiar action was satisfying, though I would hope for more choices with understandable differences.
